title: ChestHelper
description: You can fill chests with different things.
body:
# **Chest Helper**
You can fill chests with different items.

How it works:
1. Stand on a chest.
2. Enter /function chesthelper:help in chat (to find out what you have and what you want).
3. After selecting, enter /function chesthelper:item again.

**P.S. For double chests, you need to stand on each of the double chests.**
